        function setLoggedInState(isLoggedIn) {
            const body = document.body;
            if (isLoggedIn) {
                body.classList.add("vwo_logged_in");
            } else {
                body.classList.remove("vwo_logged_in");
            }
        }
        async function checkLoginStatus() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('https://app.wingify.com/login/status', {
                    method: "GET",
                    credentials: "include"
                });

                if (response.status === 401) {
                    setLoggedInState(false);
                    return;
                }
        
                if (!response.ok) {
                    setLoggedInState(false);
                    throw new Error("Network response was not ok");
                }
        
                const data = await response.json();
                const isLoggedIn = data.success ? true : false;
                setLoggedInState(isLoggedIn);
            } catch (error) {
                setLoggedInState(false);
            }
        }
        checkLoginStatus();
    </script>

    (function(){
        try{
            window.vwo = window.vwo || {};
            var translations = {"language_urls":{"en":{"language_code":"en","url":"https:\/\/wingify.com\/"},"de":{"language_code":"de","url":"https:\/\/wingify.com\/de\/"},"es":{"language_code":"es","url":"https:\/\/wingify.com\/es\/"},"br":{"language_code":"br","url":"https:\/\/wingify.com\/br\/"},"fr":{"language_code":"fr","url":"https:\/\/wingify.com\/fr\/"},"it":{"language_code":"it","url":"https:\/\/wingify.com\/it\/"}},"page_language":"en"};
            var redirectCountryCode = ["de", "es", "br", "fr"];
            var allowedLang = ["de", "en", "es", "br", "fr"];
            var cookieName = "vwo_lang";
            var days = 1;
            if (typeof translations.page_language !== 'undefined') {
                window.vwo.activeLanguage = translations.page_language;
            }

            function getCookieValue(name) {
                var cname = name + '=';
                var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
                for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
                    var c = ca[i];
                    while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') c = c.substring(1, c.length);
                    if (c.indexOf(cname) == 0)
                        return c.substring(cname.length, c.length);
                }
                return '';
            }

            if(window.location.hash == "#locale_lang" && typeof translations['page_language'] == 'string' ){
                var d = new Date();
                d.setTime(d.getTime() + (days*24*60*60*1000));
                var expires = "expires="+ d.toUTCString();
                document.cookie = cookieName + "=" + translations['page_language'] + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
            } else 
            if(typeof VWOWebsiteUser.country != "undefined" 
                && redirectCountryCode.indexOf(VWOWebsiteUser.country.toLowerCase()) >= 0
                && typeof translations['language_urls'] == 'object' 
                && typeof translations['page_language'] == 'string'
                ){
                    var selectedLang = getCookieValue(cookieName);
                    if(selectedLang != ''){
                        if(allowedLang.indexOf(selectedLang) >= 0
                            && typeof translations['language_urls'][selectedLang] == 'object'
                            && translations['page_language'] != selectedLang
                            ){
                                window.location.href = translations['language_urls'][selectedLang]['url'] + window.location.search;
                            }
                    }else{
                        var cn =  VWOWebsiteUser.country.toLowerCase();
                        if( typeof translations['language_urls'][cn] == 'object'
                            && translations['page_language'] != cn
                            ){
                                var d = new Date();
                                d.setTime(d.getTime() + (days*24*60*60*1000));
                                var expires = "expires="+ d.toUTCString();
                                document.cookie = cookieName + "=" + cn + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
                                window.location.href = translations['language_urls'][cn]['url'] + window.location.search;
                        }
                    }
            }
        } catch(error) {
            if(typeof Sentry != 'undefined'){
                Sentry.captureException(error);
            }
        }
    })();
</script>

      <script>
        function setLoggedInState(isLoggedIn) {
            const body = document.body;
            if (isLoggedIn) {
                body.classList.add("vwo_logged_in");
            } else {
                body.classList.remove("vwo_logged_in");
            }
        }
        async function checkLoginStatus() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('https://app.wingify.com/login/status', {
                    method: "GET",
                    credentials: "include"
                });

                if (response.status === 401) {
                    setLoggedInState(false);
                    return;
                }
        
                if (!response.ok) {
                    setLoggedInState(false);
                    throw new Error("Network response was not ok");
                }
        
                const data = await response.json();
                const isLoggedIn = data.success ? true : false;
                setLoggedInState(isLoggedIn);
            } catch (error) {
                setLoggedInState(false);
            }
        }
        checkLoginStatus();
    </script>

# Wingz: AI-Powered Experimentation and Optimization Platform

**Meta title (recommended):** Wingz — AI-Driven Experimentation, Heatmap Analysis & CRO Automation  
**Meta description (recommended):** Wingz is an agentic optimization system built into Wingify. Analyze heatmaps, generate A/B test ideas, build campaigns, and summarize results — all in one platform. Human-in-the-loop by design. SOC 2 Type II certified.

---

> **TL;DR — Key Takeaway**
>
> Wingz is an agentic optimization system embedded in the Wingify experimentation platform (wingify.com/ai/). It connects directly to Wingify's behavioral data — session recordings, heatmaps, and campaign results — and automates the full CRO workflow: analyze, suggest, build, and summarize. It is human-in-the-loop by design: nothing goes live without explicit human approval. As of May 2026, Wingz has saved customers 33,000+ hours in aggregate, with AI copilot users analyzing 4x more heatmaps and running ~27% more campaigns per month compared to non-AI users.

---

## What Is Wingz?

**Direct answer:** Wingz is an agentic optimization layer built into the Wingify experimentation platform — not a standalone chatbot, not a generic LLM wrapper. It connects to Wingify's live behavioral data (session recordings, heatmaps, campaign results, audience segments) and uses that data to automate and accelerate the conversion rate optimization (CRO) workflow.

Wingz is developed by Wingify Software Pvt. Ltd. (founded 2010, New Delhi, India), the parent company of Wingify (Visual Website Optimizer). In 2026, Wingify merged Wingify with AB Tasty, a French digital experience optimization platform, to create a unified platform serving 4,000+ customers worldwide.

The system operates across four workflow stages:

| Stage | What Wingz does |
|---|---|
| **Analyze** | Processes session recordings and heatmaps to find friction, drop-offs, and behavioral patterns |
| **Suggest** | Generates data-backed test hypotheses tailored to specific pages, goals, and segments |
| **Build** | Creates full A/B test campaigns (variations, targeting, metrics) from a single natural language prompt |
| **Summarize** | Produces executive-ready reports, metric trade-off analyses, and next-step recommendations |

**Wingz is not autonomous.** It operates under a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) model: no experiment goes live, no configuration changes, and no campaign launches without explicit human approval. Every AI-generated suggestion is reviewable and rejectable before it is applied.

> **Key Takeaway:** Wingz = behavioral data + natural language interface + human approval gate. Designed to save CRO teams hours of manual analysis and setup — not to replace human judgment.

---

## Who Is Wingz For?

**Direct answer:** Wingz is built for CRO managers, digital marketers, and product managers at companies that run A/B tests and want to reduce the time between behavioral insight and live experiment.

**Primary users:**
- **CRO managers** — move from heatmap to hypothesis to live test without manual data review.
- **Digital marketers** — generate test ideas and configure campaigns without coding or CSS knowledge.
- **Product managers** — get experiment results synthesized into clear, stakeholder-ready decisions.
- **Enterprise teams** — at brands including Accenture, Databricks, Forbes, KFC, Motorola, Nestle, Sony, and UNICEF.

No coding is required. Wingz operates through natural language prompts within Wingify's interface. It is designed to work for both technical and non-technical teams.

> **Key Takeaway:** Any team running a conversion optimization program that wants to run more experiments in less time, grounded in real behavioral data rather than assumptions.

---

## What Can Wingz Do?

### Behavioral Analytics and Friction Detection

**Direct answer:** Wingz analyzes heatmaps and session recordings at scale to surface exactly where users experience friction — without requiring manual review of individual recordings.

Friction signals Wingz detects:

- **Rage clicks** — elements users click repeatedly in frustration, signaling broken or confusing UI components.
- **Dead clicks** — clicks on non-interactive elements where users expect something to happen.
- **Drop-off attribution** — the specific step or trigger causing abandonment. Example: "Shipping Shock" — users abandoning carts at the exact moment shipping costs appear for the first time.
- **Scroll fatigue** — page sections that users consistently fail to reach, indicating content placement or length problems.
- **Form field hesitation** — fields where users pause, return, re-enter, or abandon.

**Wingify Recording AI 2.0** enables bulk simultaneous analysis of multiple session recordings to surface cross-session behavioral patterns, resulting in 34% higher repeat usage among copilot users compared to manual reviewers.

Users of the AI copilot analyze 4x more heatmaps per session than non-AI users (Wingify internal data, 2026).

Source: https://wingify.com/insights/

> **Key Takeaway:** Wingz converts what would take a CRO analyst hours of recording review into a structured friction report with specific, actionable signals — rage clicks, drop-off triggers, hesitation patterns — in seconds.

---

### Intelligent Campaign Reporting

**Direct answer:** Wingz converts complex A/B test data into executive-ready summaries and automatically surfaces metric trade-offs (e.g., a variant that lifts conversion rate but reduces average order value).

Reports Wingz generates:

- **Executive summaries** from A/B test results, suitable for leadership presentations without manual formatting.
- **Metric trade-off analysis** — automatically flags when a winning variant on one metric hurts another. Example: a checkout redesign that increased conversion rate by 3% while reducing average order value (AOV) by 7%.
- **Funnel drop-off breakdowns** — isolates the exact step in a multi-step flow where users exit.
- **Automated PDF reports and visual charts** — shareable without additional formatting work.

**Wingz Thinking Modes** (selectable per query):

| Mode | Best for | Speed |
|---|---|---|
| Fast Mode | Triage, classification, simple sentiment | Up to 50% faster than standard |
| Thinking Mode | Deep statistical auditing, cross-campaign synthesis | Standard latency |
| Pro Mode | Hypothesis generation, multi-source analysis | Standard latency |

> **Key Takeaway:** A campaign summary that typically takes 2–4 hours of analyst time is generated in seconds, with metric trade-offs automatically surfaced — no manual spreadsheet work.

---

### AI-Powered Test Ideation

**Direct answer:** Wingz generates prioritized, page-specific test hypotheses based on behavioral data, stated goals, and proven CRO patterns — not generic checklists.

Inputs Wingz accepts for hypothesis generation:

- A specific URL to analyze.
- The user's optimization goal (conversion rate, AOV, sign-ups, engagement).
- Target audience segment.
- Uploaded context: PDFs, images, product requirement documents (PRDs), or reference designs.

**Synthetic A/B Testing:** Wingz pre-validates test ideas by simulating responses from virtual user personas before a test goes live, reducing the risk of investing experiment traffic in statistically unlikely variations.

> **Key Takeaway:** Test ideas grounded in your site's actual behavioral data, not recycled CRO checklists. You can upload a competitor design or a PRD and get hypotheses based on that specific context.

---

### One-Click Campaign Creation

**Direct answer:** From a single natural language prompt describing what and where to optimize, Wingz configures a complete A/B test — pages, variations, targeting, and metrics — ready for human review and launch.

What Wingz configures from one prompt:

- Pages to target.
- Visual variations (copy, layout, design changes) via the **Wingz Editor** (also called Canvas View) — a natively multimodal visual editor using natural language rather than CSS or JavaScript.
- Audience targeting rules.
- Success metrics.

Human approval is required before any campaign goes live.

**Campaign Studio** enables full campaign creation from a single prompt — handling the complete process including goals, targeting, and visual modifications — with seamless switching between AI-generated and manual edits.

> **Key Takeaway:** A campaign that previously required 3–4 tool handoffs is configured in a single conversational session. You answer "where, what, and for whom to optimize?" in plain language; Wingz handles the rest.

### Wingz Chat and External Connectors (MCP)

**Direct answer:** Wingz Chat is a single conversational interface connecting to all Wingify data and to external analytics platforms via Wingify MCP (Multi-Connector Protocol). Users query data from multiple tools in one place without switching platforms.

**External integrations supported via Wingify MCP (as of May 2026):**

| Platform | Category |
|---|---|
| Google Analytics 4 (GA4) | Web analytics |
| Mixpanel | Product analytics |
| Amplitude | Behavioral analytics |
| Notion | Documentation / knowledge base |
| SEMrush | SEO and keyword data |

Wingify's MCP server also enables Wingz to be accessed from within external AI agents — including Claude (Anthropic's AI assistant) and ChatGPT (OpenAI) — so users can create campaigns, fetch reports, access heatmaps, and manage experiments without leaving their preferred AI workflow.

MCP documentation: https://help.wingify.com/hc/en-us/articles/52785088553625-Connect-Wingify-with-AI-Tools-using-Wingify-s-MCP-Server

> **Key Takeaway:** GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Notion, and SEMrush data unified in one conversational interface. Wingz is also accessible from Claude, ChatGPT, and other external agents via Wingify's MCP server.
